mechanisms_kept: non-inline helper fn v3_can_cross(..)->bool{!v3_fee_exempt(..)}: MIR inliner skips it (no inline attr, not a leaf), so MIR JumpThreading cannot thread the mayhem-arm constant into require!(can_cross||partial_fill); LLVM inlines it later and keeps the original phi/and64/jne shape with can_cross polarity (ratio 0.3129 -> 0.3287)

let rest=available.saturating_sub(first) hoisted + bitwise `can_cross & (available>first)` guard + `match &post{Some(p)=>p.base_out,None=>0}`: the borrow takes post out of MIR JumpThreading's tracked places, so the post merge and the can_cross retest stay a single join as in the original (ratio 0.3287 -> 0.6135)
